Select Projects Edited by Zoey Rose Best
for Long Gone Production Home

paragraphs: Featuring Wendy Whelan, Associate Artistic Director of New York City Ballet, and Victoria Morgan, Artistic Director of Cincinnati Ballet. Led by Kathryn Roszak, Artistic Director of Danse Lumière. This conversation highlights the need for women in leadership roles in the arts, in production, and in corporate positions.
